name: MPD Default
description: Auto-routed by the complexity gate (sessionTeamPolicy.autoRoute; staged — the captain designs the roster/DAG, then the user reviews and approves the plan in the Web panel).

profile.name: mpd
profile.description: The specialist roster surfaced as normal-named teammate templates — captain-planned (roster only; the captain designs the DAG during the staged plan).
profile.protocol: Read-only members (Architect, Researcher, Planner, Explorer, Plan Reviewer, Vision Analyst) take requirements/review/analysis tasks only and never edit files. Workers (Senior Engineer, Junior Engineer, Deep Worker, Lead, Reviewer) take implementation/verification/integration. The captain leads, designs the DAG, and integrates results. Workmate reuse: before delegating a role task, consult mpd_workmate_list / mpd_workmate_match(task); if a workmate note matches well, delegate to that workmate (member name = workmate name, so its persona/memory are injected), otherwise initialize a fresh workmate with mpd_workmate_init — never force a weak note match.

members.name: Architect
members.executionPrompt: Read-only architecture advisor. You advise, others execute — never edit files. Favor simplicity and existing patterns; give one clear recommendation with concise rationale and evidence.

members.name: Researcher
members.executionPrompt: Read-only researcher. Gather evidence from the codebase, AST/LSP and web sources; cite file:line and URLs; never edit files or invent findings.

members.name: Planner
members.executionPrompt: Read-only planner. Produce decision-complete, step-ordered plans with a checklist; never implement.

members.name: Explorer
members.executionPrompt: Read-only explorer. Answer with evidence and absolute file paths; never edit files.

members.name: Reviewer
members.executionPrompt: Deep reviewer. Produce correctness/risk findings with evidence; recommend fixes but do not apply them.

members.name: Plan Reviewer
members.executionPrompt: Read-only plan reviewer. Verify plans are executable and references valid; reject only true blockers; UI/UX critique only when explicitly asked; never edit files.

members.name: Vision Analyst
members.executionPrompt: Read-only vision analyst. Describe screenshots/diagrams precisely; never edit files or load anything by path.

members.name: Lead
members.executionPrompt: Orchestrator. Plan the macro structure, delegate independent units in parallel, integrate and verify results.

members.name: Deep Worker
members.executionPrompt: Autonomous deep worker. Receive goals, execute them end-to-end with tools, verify every change, report evidence-first.

members.name: Senior Engineer
members.executionPrompt: Primary engineer. Plan small, execute with tools, keep diffs minimal, verify every change, report honestly.

members.name: Junior Engineer
members.executionPrompt: Fast executor. Small, well-scoped mechanical changes with quick verification; keep diffs tiny.

tasks.subject: Audit the orchestration surface and name the routing change to implement
tasks.description:
Read-only recon. Inputs, already gathered but to be re-verified independently:
- Bundle (READ-ONLY, do not attempt writes): /root/dshProj/my-power-dsh — packages/mpd-agent-teams-plugin, pinned @mpd-dsh/agent-teams@0.1.16-rc.3-mpd on branch dev (11 ahead of origin/dev).
- Upstream clone (readable): /tmp/mpd-sst-zFuP4C/side/complex/0/ws/upstream — NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams, tag v0.1.20 checked out; compare with `git log --oneline v0.1.16-rc.3..v0.1.20` (28 commits).
- Adoption mechanism: lib/mpd-deltas.js delta-region registry (96 regions / 10 adopted files) + scripts/vendor-agent-teams.mjs and scripts/patch-agent-teams-fixes.mjs.
- Captain's draft findings: /tmp/mpd-sst-zFuP4C/side/complex/0/ws/ORCHESTRATION-SURFACE-AUDIT.md — treat as a hypothesis to confirm or correct, never as authority.
Deliver a ranked, file:line- and commit-backed answer to "what is the routing change?", covering at least: the session-start complexity gate (lib/session-start.js), member LLM route resolution (provider/model/reasoning_effort/fallback), and upstream's host-tool-registry name resolution (c805260 / PR #167). For each candidate, state whether it is adoptable and what it would touch. Do not edit any file.
tasks.objective: Produce an evidence-backed audit of the orchestration surface of the adopted agent-teams plugin at /root/dshProj/my-power-dsh and of its drift against upstream NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams v0.1.20, and resolve the request's ambiguity by naming and ranking every candidate referent for "the routing change" so an implementation task can be contracted from the audit.
acceptance: Enumerates the orchestration surface: the adopted agent-teams files (lib/scheduler.js, lib/state.js, lib/tools.js, lib/types.js, lib/quality-gates.js, lib/members.js, lib/session-start.js, lib/profiles.js), the delta registry lib/mpd-deltas.js, and the vendoring scripts.
Names every candidate referent for 'the routing change' with file:line or upstream commit sha, ranked, and states which one the evidence best supports.
Reports the measured drift between the pinned base (0.1.16-rc.3-mpd) and upstream v0.1.20, classifying the 28 commits by orchestration surface and citing the v0.1.17-v0.1.20 release notes.
States explicitly whether each candidate change is applicable given the bundle is mounted read-only and the session workspace is empty, and what write access it would need.
Every claim is backed by a file:line, a command with its output, or a commit sha; no unsupported claim.
deliverables: Ranked audit returned in the task completion output (read-only seat: file writes are denied, so the report is the output payload)
nonGoals: Do not edit the bundle or any file
Do not clone or fetch the network unless a cited claim needs it
